items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: It is known that the whole matter of the new MAH, which is the world of Atzilut, is only to correct the BAN, which are all the statures that emerged in the Gadlut of Nekudim, which were nullified and shattered; and by the couplings of the new MAH in Atzilut, they receive their correction, all the statures returning to enter as they were before the nullification and the shattering. And it is known that they are divided into two divisions: for first the heads of the upper Aba and Ima emerged, whose from-above-downward are the four kings of the HGT up to the chest; and because of the shattering of these four kings, the Achoraim of the upper Aba and Ima were also nullified, which are all the aspect of their AHAP that rose to them at the time of the emergence of their statures, from below upward; after the nullification of the statures, these Achoraim returned and fell to the place of their bodies, namely to the place where the kings of the HGT stood. And afterward, the four statures of the YESHSUT of Nekudim emerged, from below upward, whose from-above-downward are the four kings of NHY M. And after their shattering — the four kings of NHY M — the Achoraim of YESHSUT were also nullified, which are the AHAP that joined to them at the time of the emergence of these statures, from below upward; and after their nullification, the AHAP of every stature returned and fell to the place of its body, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:2
items.html: And it is found that the end of correction cannot be before these Achoraim that fell from Aba and Ima and YESHSUT return to their place, as at first, before their nullification; and then all the vessels of the eight kings will also be corrected with them, and they will return to be Atzilut in their place, as at first. For every stature that is corrected in Aba and Ima and YESHSUT raises from BYA also the vessels belonging to the from-above-downward of that stature, as is known. And the order of the raising of these Achoraim is discerned in five aspects.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:3
items.html: The first aspect is in the Mochin of the weekday, which are the aspect of YESHSUT, coming by the bowing of the head of the Yechida-Chaya down to the place of the Neshama. Then ZA raises, with his MAN, only the aspect of the Achoraim that fell from the YESHSUT of Nekudim to the place of the HGT of AA, where ZA stands at the time of his Ibur; that stature raises the vessels and sparks of the four kings of NHY M of Nekudim that are in BYA. However, this raising is not a complete raising even for the Achoraim of YESHSUT, because the place of the raising of the Achoraim must be in the place of the GAR of AA, whose place is aligned opposite the place of the emergence of the Yeshut and Tevunah of Nekudim. For the GAR of AA clothe the HGT of Atik, which stand in the place of the four kings of the HGT, in whose place the head of the YESHSUT of Nekudim emerged. And since the raising of the Achoraim was only to the place of the HGT of AA, and the coupling was made by the bowing of the head of Aba and Ima, from the place of the GAR of AA to the place of his HGT, as is known — therefore the Achoraim of YESHSUT have still not risen in this to their true place, as at first.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:4
items.html: The second aspect is in the Mochin of Shabbat at Musaf, when ZON ascend as MAN to the place of the GAR of AA, and raise there the Achoraim of YESHSUT, which then stand in the GAR of AA. And here a complete raising is made of the Achoraim of YESHSUT, for now YESHSUT stand in their place, in their standing at the time of Nekudim, for the GAR of AA are aligned opposite the YESHSUT of Nekudim, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:5
items.html: The third aspect is the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, which ZON also raise in that same ascent of the Ibur, to the place of the GAR of AA, namely on Shabbat at Musaf, as above. For, with regard to the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, it is similar to the first aspect with regard to the Achoraim of YESHSUT, mentioned above: they have still not risen to their true place, which is the place of the GAR of Atik, for the GAR of Atik stand aligned in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, where is the standing of the Aba and Ima of Nekudim, as is known. Rather, they are still in the place of their fall, which is the place of the HGT of Nekudim, namely the place of the GAR of AA, as above, except that they receive correction by the bowing of the head of Aba and Ima, who are now in the place of the GAR of Nekudim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:6
items.html: The fourth aspect is at Shabbat Mincha, when ZA ascends as MAN in an Ibur to YESHSUT, who stand in the place of the GAR of Atik; and it is found that he now raises the Achoraim of Aba and Ima to their true place, to the place of the GAR of Nekudim. And there is now a complete raising also for the Achoraim of Aba and Ima. However, there is still a lack in the aspect of the stature, for here at Shabbat Mincha there is only the stature of the SAG of the Yechida of ZA; therefore the Nukva can no longer ascend with him as MAN, to the place of the GAR of Atik, and he is divided, because of this, into two Partzufim, of which only ZA and Leah can receive these Mochin and clothe the GAR of AA; but Jacob and Rachel remained below, in the place of the HGT of AA, as is known. Therefore, all the Achoraim of Aba and Ima have still not risen in completeness.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:7
items.html: (To the question) The fifth aspect is at the end of correction, when the Nukva will also be fit to raise MAN to the GAR of Atik, for then the Malchut hidden in RADLA will be revealed, in the secret of the cornerstone. And then all the aspects of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima will rise in completeness, to their place, as at first; and then there will be the end of correction. And in order to understand this answer well, one must well remember all that is explained in Answer 9, see there.
